[7:41PM] #Ikorodu #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic beyond Benson is moving slowly toward Ikorodu Interchange, mainly due to market activities and frequent pedestrian crossings.
The route from Aleje through Sabo Roundabout, connecting First Gate, Jendol, REDEEM, and up to ENYO Filling Station, is experiencing smooth traffic. However, the stretch from there toward Odonguyan axis is busy due to activities at bus stops and pedestrian movements.
There is good movement from Ojubode inward Oba’s Palace and from the Ikorodu Interchange. 
The return trip through Owolowo, Ojubode, Ladega, and Onishigida is free-flowing. The area remains calm from Itunpate through Itunmeko to the Ota-Ona corridor.
Traffic on Obafemi Awolowo Road, both inbound and outbound, is very good despite ongoing diversions.
No obstructions reported, and traffic structures are well-positioned with officers effectively managing the flow.
